areas.name: Concurrent repository integrity
areas.description: Two agents writing to the same repository at the same time can overwrite or lose each other's work, and the failure usually shows up only under one specific ordering of events, which makes it hard to reproduce and easy to miss.

areas.name: Evidence and retrieval quality
areas.description: A language model states things with the same confidence whether or not a source supports them, and will retrieve a plausible wrong document as readily as the right one.

filings.title: Authority-aware context routing and retrieval-quality gating
Evidence-grounding for AI-generated assessments
Evidence-grounding for cited values
Conjunctive detection of omitted and unsupported content against the current text of a cited source

areas.name: Provenance and artifact coherence
areas.description: Once a record is machine-written and machine-updated, nothing in the record itself shows who wrote it, when, or whether it still matches the data it was derived from.

areas.name: Coordination, fleet governance, and session continuity
areas.description: An agent can exit in the middle of a task, and work marked as owned by a process that no longer exists is invisible to every other agent, so it sits untouched indefinitely.

areas.name: Measurement and detector validity
areas.description: A detector is trustworthy only after it has been shown to fire on a real fault and stay quiet on a clean input. These filings separate a negative measurement from a check that never ran.
